thread:
nina: Quick sync on billing dashboard copy + layout: users keep confusing the CSV export with the invoice PDF. proposal: two explicit CTAs in header: `Download invoice (PDF)` and `Export line items (CSV)`. Move chargeback CSV into kebab menu. Thoughts?

alex: Strong +1. we should also add a tiny descriptor under the CSV CTA: 'contains per-call line items, not a human-readable invoice'.

troy: UI placement: if we put both CTAs in the summary card header it gets crowded on narrow screens. idea: primary CTA = PDF (left), secondary (`Export line items`) inside a persistent toolbar top-right with scope toggle. on mobile collapse to icon + dropdown.

sara: Agree. Also: the token vs $ toggle belongs in the same toolbar so users see unit + scope together. show a pill that reads e.g. `Tokens • Org` so state is explicit.

nina: UX microcopy: change ambiguous 'Download invoice' to 'Download invoice (PDF)'. change 'Export' to 'Export CSV (line items)'. we should update tooltips and screen-reader text too.

billing-bot: Note: attached latest invoice layout: /internal/billing/invoice-layout-v4.pdf and line-items-spec.csv

alex: Chart behavior: default sparkline for density, with a keyboard-focusable 'Details' affordance that overlays a stacked breakdown by token type. hover/focus opens breakdown; clicking pins it. Keeps dashboard compact but accessible.

troy: Accessibility: token colors need patterned fills for print and colorblind-safe palette. also ensure all text meets 4.5:1 contrast. add an aria-describedby for the token legend.

sara: For scope defaults: analytics show most org admins want org-level default. suggestion: default to org for admin users, otherwise persist last-view-per-user. add a small 'Viewing: Org — ACME' label in the toolbar so it's always visible.

nina: Implementation detail: store preference in user settings and support a local quick-toggle. add a 'reset to org' tiny link for admins when viewing project scope.

alex: Dev ask: can design provide two summary card templates (full-width detailed + compact 60% width) and CSS tokens for the toolbar icon-only state (breakpoint at 900px)? I'll prototype responsive behavior once I have tokens.

troy: Also add a confirmation toast for CSV exports and move chargeback CSV into the kebab with an extra confirmation modal. Prevent accidental exports.

sara: Copy review: change 'Export chargeback CSV' to 'Export chargeback report (CSV) — includes allocation columns' so users know what they're getting.

nina: I'll produce mocks for: 1) toolbar with token/$ + scope pill, 2) two card widths, 3) sparkline with accessible overlay, and 4) explicit CTAs. sharing in #design in ~25m. will include aria labels and legend descriptions.

billing-bot: FYI: lineitem export endpoint renamed to /api/billing/exports/v3 — devs please note for confirmations.

alex: Thanks. tagging @eng-frontend and @design-ops for contrast patterns. we'll iterate after mock drop.
